svg.aria-label: Diagram of my text-to-image DCGAN generator: a caption encoded by CLIP and projected to 128 values, joined with 100 noise values, then upsampled through 4x4x512, 8x8x256, 16x16x128 and 32x32x64 feature maps to a 64x64 colour image.
